scope: Current formal requirements, stable handoff checkpoints, item state, completion outputs, and separate Museum claim. This package contains no route ordering or strategic valuation.

sources.used_for: Requirements, start, NPC sequence, locations, quest completion, rewards, and Museum claim relationship.
Research package handoff and replacement behavior.
Package delivery, research notes receipt, and notes replacement.

checkpoints.location: Lumbridge Castle first floor (UK), Duke Horacio
checkpoints.description: Accept Rune Mysteries from Duke Horacio and receive one air talisman.

observation.instruction: Confirm the quest was accepted and the air talisman was received.
observation.runelite_boundary: Character Exporter does not provide a stable in-progress stage; an air talisman alone is not stage-exclusive.

promotion.reason: Await central review of the minimum useful macroquesting milestones.

checkpoints.description: Give Sedridor the air talisman and receive one research package.

observation.instruction: Confirm the talisman handoff and research package receipt.
observation.runelite_boundary: Inventory presence is point-in-time evidence and replacement behavior prevents it from being a universal stage proof.

promotion.reason: Stable factual handoff, pending usefulness and integration review.

checkpoints.description: Give Aubury the research package and receive one research notes.

observation.instruction: Confirm Aubury accepted the package and supplied the notes.
observation.runelite_boundary: Character Exporter does not export this handoff; item observation alone does not establish its full history.

promotion.reason: Stable factual handoff, pending usefulness and integration review.

checkpoints.description: Give Sedridor the research notes and observe Rune Mysteries completion.

observation.instruction: Confirm Rune Mysteries is finished in the quest list or imported as FINISHED.
observation.runelite_boundary: FINISHED safely proves completion but does not prove a Museum claim.

promotion.reason: The graph has a quest node but actions.json does not yet contain a Rune Mysteries completion action.

checkpoints.location: Varrock Museum first floor (UK), Historian Minas
checkpoints.description: After quest completion, separately claim five Kudos from Historian Minas.

observation.instruction: Confirm the Historian Minas interaction separately from quest completion.
observation.runelite_boundary: Quest completion cannot prove the claim; the existing normalized claim action requires separate confirmation.

promotion.reason: Already represented by a separate normalized claim action rather than partial quest state.

unlocks: Rune essence mine access through eligible wizard teleports
Runecraft becomes eligible for random-event lamps and books of knowledge
post_completion_claims: 5 Varrock Museum Kudos from Historian Minas through action:claim-minas-rune-mysteries
